# Toadstone

> Toadstone is a free, self-hosted SEO crawler. It joins Google Search Console and Analytics data to the crawl, and ships an MCP server so coding agents can read a crawl and fix what it finds. Source-available under the Elastic License 2.0 (not OSI open source).

Toadstone is source-available under the Elastic License 2.0. Docs are plain Markdown; each page also has an HTML twin at the same address with `.html` instead of `.md`.

## Docs

- [The check reference](https://spcaeo.github.io/toadstone/docs/checks.md): Every check Toadstone can report (222 in total), with its slug, its severity and what to do about it.
- [Toadstone MCP server](https://spcaeo.github.io/toadstone/docs/mcp.md): Ten tools that let a coding agent read a crawl and find what is wrong with a site, read-only by default, with setup for Claude Code and Cursor, its guardrails and its transports.
- [Agent handoff: fix the SEO issues from a Toadstone crawl](https://spcaeo.github.io/toadstone/docs/agent-handoff.md): A paste-in prompt that hands a crawl to a coding agent: read the issues over the HTTP API, fix them in the site code, re-crawl and compare.
- [The agent layer, and how to give it a model](https://spcaeo.github.io/toadstone/docs/agents.md): How Toadstone can ask a language model to judge pages, why it is off by default, the three agentMode settings, and the Docker bridge for cli mode.
- [Connecting Google Search Console and Analytics](https://spcaeo.github.io/toadstone/docs/google.md): The one-time OAuth client setup, the four read-only scopes, where the credential is stored and how errors are explained.
- [Writing a plugin](https://spcaeo.github.io/toadstone/docs/plugins.md): How to add a tab to Toadstone with one JavaScript file and no build step, with the registration API, lifecycle hooks and styling classes.
- [The name](https://spcaeo.github.io/toadstone/docs/about-the-name.md): Why the tool is called Toadstone, what a toadstone was, and where the project comes from: a fork of LibreCrawl.

## Optional

- [Documentation index](https://spcaeo.github.io/toadstone/docs/index.md): all pages with one-line descriptions.
- [Live demo](https://spcaeo.github.io/toadstone/): the real interface frozen over a real crawl, no sign-up.
- [Guided tour](https://spcaeo.github.io/toadstone/watch.html): a short video tour of the interface.
- [Source code and README](https://github.com/spcaeo/toadstone): the repository, including the README, LICENSE and CHANGELOG.
